title: Robin In The Hood
style: Phonk hip-hop with hyper-speed bounce, militant kick-snare swing, warped cowbells, and rubbery sub-bass; verse rides tight and clipped, pre-chorus strips to snare ticks and whispered count-ins, chorus slams with gang shouts and chopped vocal stabs. Lead vocal is gritty and close-mic with doubled hook lines, ad-lib pings and call-response shouts. Siren risers, tape-stop flips, and reversed bell sweeps drive transitions; mix is dark, punchy, and wide in the low end., fake, rock, bounce
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Maths driver on the map
Delta, alpha, plan it fast
Three mirrors in the glass
One wrong move and we’re gone past

Heres my boys, thrash this toy
Take the right lane, make no noise
Police chatter in the back
Unit three three six on track

Fake a break, then bend the bend
Cash back drop, we cash in then
Thrash this toy, catch that boy
Sneak through smoke, don’t lose your poise

[Pre-Chorus]
Chase and cage
We don’t stall
Free birds rock
Hear the call

Math Driver
Set the dream
Hold the wheel
Hit the seam

[Chorus]
A robin in the hood
A robin in the hood
A robin in the hood
Ah robin for good!

Cash back drop
What a shock
Chase and cage
Free birds rock

A robin in the hood
A robin in the hood
A robin in the hood
Ah robin for good!

[Verse 2]
Hyper speed, no time to breathe
Sirens sound when we leave
Unit three three six behind
But the plan stays locked in mind

I can, you got this, we believe
Math Driver, don’t you freeze
Out the mansion, out the maze
Turn that panic into phase

Extra stripe for no rage
Phonky sneaky, thrift drift play
Give them rage in our cage
Then we vanish, clean escape

[Pre-Chorus]
Chase and cage
We don’t stall
Free birds rock
Hear the call

Math Driver
Set the dream
Hold the wheel
Hit the seam

[Chorus]
A robin in the hood
A robin in the hood
A robin in the hood
Ah robin for good!

Cash back drop
What a shock
Chase and cage
Free birds rock

A robin in the hood
A robin in the hood
A robin in the hood
Ah robin for good!

[Bridge]
The architect, the plan
The dream done safe, done sound
Our robin, our robin
Run it through this town

[Break]
Ha bro, if we could
Bust ’em like we should
You heard the sarg
We were up and good

[Final Chorus]
A robin in the hood
A robin in the hood
A robin in the hood
Ah robin for good!

Cash back drop
What a shock
Chase and cage
Free birds rock

A robin in the hood
A robin in the hood
A robin in the hood
Ah robin for good!
